👉Video Introduction
Mumbai is one of the most expensive real estate markets in the world.
But the real question is this. Is it actually creating wealth or trapping capital?

In this episode of the Indian Business Podcast, we sit down with Vishal Bhargava, Founder of BHK Voice and one of the most credible voices in Indian real estate.

Unlike brokers or builders, Vishal is not incentivised to sell anything. His insights come from data, on ground research, and sharp analysis.

A year ago, when he decoded Gurgaon’s real estate market on our podcast, his predictions turned out to be incredibly accurate as the market corrected soon after.

And now, he turns his attention to Mumbai.

In this episode, we break down
• Why Mumbai homes are so expensive
• The biggest problems in Mumbai’s real estate market
• Why luxury housing may be more hype than reality
• A clear framework to identify the next multibagger locations
• Investment opportunities from 2 crore to 10 crore plus

Whether you are planning to buy your first home, upgrade your lifestyle, or simply want to understand where the market is headed, this episode will completely change how you look at Mumbai real estate.

Watch till the end.
